thread:
Rae T.: spotting a tiny drift during rollout for `session_routing_v3` — console shows version 3 but a sliver of edge clients still running v1.
Diego N.: concrete evidence?
Rae T.: sample log: 
```
edge-client[pid]: flag=session_routing_v3 if-none-match: W/"v1-99" -> 304, used_local=v1
```
while console's /flags API returns v3 with etag W/"v3-122".
Olga V.: suspects: proxy strip of custom headers or client 304 handling. we added X-Flag-Version in the last config patch.
infra-bot: alert: config-drift-detected (flag=session_routing_v3, rate=0.0007) -> INC-5034
Diego N.: propose quick changes: (1) edge-client: on 304, check any version headers and if mismatch, issue GET; (2) proxy: ensure X-Flag-Version is forwarded on 304; (3) metric: emit flag.sync.retry(reason=304_mismatch).
Rae T.: i'll open the client PR with a unit test that simulates a 304 + mismatched header -> triggers GET. Also add a tiny console "sync" indicator behind feature flag console.feature.sync_health.
Olga V.: ops runbook for now:
```
# check proxies
curl -sI https://edge-proxy.eu.internal/flags/session_routing_v3 | egrep -i 'ETag|X-Flag-Version' || true
```
Diego N.: canary plan: land client fix -> canary region eu-west-1 at 10% for 30m, monitor flag.sync.retry and page if >0.05% over 10m.
Rae T.: thanks all, tagging @Diego N. and @Olga V. :thumbsup:
